title: A Combine camera room: one screen, a button that steps through the cameras, and the sound of the room you watch
rule: A guard room has one monitor and three or four fixed cameras looking down into the block. Each press of the console button steps to the next camera with a click, a small light per channel shows which is on, and the picture breaks into static for a moment as it changes. A microphone at each camera plays that room's sound through the screen while its channel is on. The screen and microphones run only while someone is in the room. Choosing a camera can start something small there, seen only on the screen (two guards walking through and out of view). A new use for our Combine consoles: ask the owner first.
why: Four camera rooms in d2_prison_02, 03, 04, 05: one func_monitor, 3 or 4 point_camera (FOV 60 on 9 of 15, 20 to 75; pitched down 10 to 32 degrees on most, fog 2048 to 4096), func_button flags 1025, wait 0.3. Press: monitor_counter (startvalue 1, max 3 or 4, OnHitMax SetValue 0) OutValue > monitor_case.InValue > camera_N_relay: monitor_1.SetCamera, monitor_sound_1 (k_lab.monitorbutton, flags 48), monitor_sprite_N ShowSprite and the others HideSprite (glow01, scale .05), the button sprite Color 255 0 0 then 0 255 0 @0.3. d2_prison_02 camera_1 to 4_microphone: env_microphone MaxRange 512 to 1024, spawnflags 31, SpeakerName monitor_1, speaker_dsp_preset 58 or 59, enabled with their channel; a trigger_multiple round the room: StartTouch monitor Enable, EndTouch monitor and microphones Disable. d2_prison_05 laundry_camera_relay: the camera's two soldiers ForceSpawn, a schedule walks each to a path_corner whose OnPass Kills them, Surveillance_monitor_static1 Enable/Disable at 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 1.1, 1.2; a trigger_look on the screen fires it unasked (d2_prison_03, 05). d2_prison_08 logic_assault_blastdoor_1 and 2: the console's big monitor shows blastdoor_sec_camera_1 while the squad outside gathers (scripted run @0.1), the leader plays signal_group @0.2 and signal_advance @1.4, they move up @2.6, the monitor goes off @5 and the on-screen men are Killed @6; the real attack comes through the door later.
how: Gamemode: the Combine console (city-events.md, 'Flying a scanner') could offer 'Watch the cameras': render-target views from 3 or 4 editor points ('Point: security camera') in the prison and the nexus, stepped with E or the number keys, a 0.1 to 1 s static overlay on each change, the nearest sounds at the camera relayed quietly to the watcher, nothing drawn when nobody watches. Map modules: lc_cam_N points (angles pitched 10 to 30 down) in prison and nexus pieces.
check: review; a client smoke check that the render target is only drawn while someone uses the console

title: A Combine door opens in steps: lock light, beep, the model moves, then the passage clears
rule: A Combine door does not just slide: its lock light comes on, an unlock beep follows a tenth of a second later, the door model starts its opening animation at half a second, the light goes out, and only at about 1.25 s does the way through clear (the solid part moves or the player clip goes off); the model settles into its open idle at 5 s. Big blast doors are many leaves opened one after another over about 2.5 s, and only some of the leaves make a sound. Changes how our Combine doors feel when they open: ask the owner first.

The interrogation room door (introom_door_1) is the same model with pClip_introom_door_1 Disabled as it opens. d2_prison_08 logic_door_comb_1_open: ten func_door leaves Open @0, 0.8, 1, 1.1, 1.5, 1.6, 1.9, 2.1, 2.3, 2.5, speeds 60 to 100, lips 16 to 68; 6 leaves sound (Doors.Move10, FullOpen10), 4 are flag 4096 silent; the close relay runs the same in another order with the player clip on first.

Map modules: m.combine_door() as a prop_dynamic combine_door01 with a clip brush and a lock sprite; m.blast_door(leaves) giving each leaf its own delay and sound on every other leaf.

title: A Combine force field is a see-through shield and a clip that lets the Combine through
rule: Build a field from two parts: the shield you see (never solid) and a clip that does the blocking, either for everyone but Combine soldiers or for players only. Its poles show it is on, and turn dark with it. It hums within about 500 and buzzes while someone stands in it. Switched off, its sound fades out over half a second, sparks fly, the poles go dark. Our checkpoint forcefields block people by the gamemode: matching Valve's build, or letting Combine NPCs walk through, changes them: ask the owner first.

Poles combine_fence01a and 01b Skin(1) when off. Sound: combine.sheild_loop (radius 500) and combine.sheild_touch started by a trigger_multiple round the field (StartTouch PlaySound, EndTouch StopSound). d2_prison_03 plug_pull2: hall_field Kill, forcefield3_sound_close and far Volume(.1) then Kill @1, sparks, turret_hall_poles Skin(1); d2_prison_06 logic_shield_off2: shutdown sound @0.2, Volume(0) @0.5. d2_prison_07 logic_room5_begin_assault turns four fields on across the gates @3 while the gates open and their node links TurnOn @5: players shut in, soldiers through.

Gamemode: the checkpoint field (city-people.md) could buzz while touched and fade its hum when the power bank dies.
check: map_lint 'wire': a combineshield brush entity that is solid (Solidity not 1), or one with no clip twin in its box

title: A door forced from outside is heard long before it gives: voices, blows, then beeps that quicken
rule: When attackers break into a held room, the defenders hear them first: voices behind the door now and then, a heavy blow and a shake on a slow beat, the beat quickening once the defenders are ready, then a charge's beeps coming faster and faster for about 8 s before the door blows and the first attackers come straight through. Nothing on screen says it. Changes how our raids and breaches play: ask the owner first.

title: A guard tower's gun is manned, lit while manned, and holds its fire until the tower is attacked
rule: A tower gun has a man at it; its spotlight rides the gun and is lit only while someone mans it. It locks on for a second or more before it fires, and does little harm to a person at range. It does not reach far until one of the tower's men is hurt; then it opens its range and aims at the attacker. Its first shot sounds the alarm for the whole yard. A tower whose crew is dead is shut. Changes how our checkpoints and turrets behave: ask the owner first.

title: A held room under steady pressure: each attacker killed is replaced a second later, until the time is up
rule: Besides waves, Valve holds a room by keeping a set number of attackers alive: each death spawns one replacement a second later at a randomly chosen spawn point, the first few deaths each add one more (it gets harder), a manhack comes back ten seconds after it falls. When the time is up nobody new comes, and the hold ends when the last attacker is dead. An attacker who is stuck must not keep it open: a trigger over every place they reach notices when none are left, and a failsafe ends it a few minutes after the time anyway. Fits the owner's exception to house rule 9 (holding ground against attacks); changes how our counterattacks run: ask the owner first.

Control room 2: 'Trigger fires when all combine in the wave are killed. Should stretch over all the places combine get to' (trigger_multiple filter Combine and manhacks, EndTouchAll > finished @6) and logic_croom2_failsafe 180 s after the 480 s timer: 'on the assumption it's because a combine's stuck somewhere'.

Tests: the count never passes N plus 4; the hold ends with a stuck attacker.
check: a unit test of the cap and the failsafe; robots.py: a hold where attackers cannot path still ends

title: The PA speaks at each turn of events and names the block
rule: The prison's places are lettered and numbered, and the Overwatch voice names them: contact in block B2, the intruder in block D8, kill the prisoners in A7. A line plays once, when something changes (a stage is reached, a gate opens, enough guards are down), heard within a block (1250) and only the gravest across the prison. Soldiers' radio chatter names its control room the same way. Changes what our PA says: ask the owner first.

title: A prisoner held in beams, freed by pulling the plug
rule: Valve's interrogation rig holds the prisoner inside a force field with beams from two poles, lit by thin spotlights and humming with three machine loops that start as someone comes near. Freeing him is one physical act, pulling the plug out of the wall: the beams cut out in two steps a quarter second apart, the end glows die, three shutdown sounds follow over half a second, the field goes, the poles go dark. A new piece for our interrogation room and prison breaks: ask the owner first.

title: The prison's machines run on a beat of their own: pod lines halt and go, trains come through
rule: The Combine's machinery keeps moving with nobody watching, on loops that call themselves: prisoner pods on their conveyors halt for 2 or 3 s every 18 to 22 s and move on; a train sounds its horn, moves off a second later, shakes the ground in steps as it passes and is removed at the end of its track; the next comes some 35 s after. Prisoners are shown this way, in pods and on monitors, not kept standing in cells. Changes how our trains and depot behave: ask the owner first.

title: Lights come back bank by bank with a clunk, and go out the same way before an ambush
rule: When power comes back, a room's lights do not all come on at once: one bank, then the next two seconds later, the last after six, each with a clunk and its lamp model turning lit. When the Combine strike in the dark, they kill the lights the same way, one by one half a second apart, each with its own clunk, and then light the target with flares. No flicker (the owner's rule): each light changes once. Changes how our blackouts end: ask the owner first.

title: Combine floor turrets stand in pairs, with a soldier close by

d2_prison_07, Valve's comment: 'When a turret is first tipped ... once a turret gets deployed after tipping once, we know the player has learned to pick them up again': turret OnTipped > keepturretsup_relay (a line @2, keepturretsup_timer RefireTime 20 cycling four lines), turret OnDeploy > player_learned_turret_reset Kills both; env_speaker nags (concepts EnterIntRoomNag, ExitIntRoomNag, ExitAGaunt1Nag) every 10 to 18 s or 16 to 24 s, turned on 10 to 12 s after a scene and off or Killed the moment the player moves.

Nova Prospekt's hallways use explosive tripmines instead (d2_prison_03 to 06, 12 in d2_prison_05): a red env_beam (BoltWidth .5, TextureScroll 35, TouchedByEntity > mine Break), a backup trigger_once along the beam for players, NPCs and physics (spawnflags 11), a 1-health func_breakable over the mine and an npc_bullseye (autoaimradius 28) so it can be shot from afar; Break: env_explosion magnitude 100, beam TurnOff, backup trigger and clip Killed.

Nova Prospekt firms it: d2_prison_05 kitchen doors (prop_door_rotating) FullyOpen > kitchen_door_N_link TurnOn, FullyClosed > TurnOff; d2_prison_07 door_croom2_gate Close > link TurnOff, FullyOpen > TurnOn; room 5's four gates Open @3 and their info_node_link_controllers TurnOn @5; d2_prison_01 booth_2_nodelink TurnOn from a trigger and from bugbait.

Nova Prospekt's gates show their state with a pair of glow sprites switched by the door's own outputs (d2_prison_03 showers_gate2: Open > light_closed Hide, light_open Show; FullyClosed > the reverse); a gate lever (func_rot_button distance 150, speed 150, sounds 22, wait -1) turns its sprite green OnIn; force field poles take Skin(1) when the field is off; lamp models take Skin(1) as their light comes on.

d2_prison_01: a guard tower gun's first shot (func_tank OnFire > tower_N_alarm_relay @1) shows that tower's glow sprite and starts two looped sirens (coast.bunker_siren1 and 2, radius 10000, flags 17) for the whole yard; one relay_stop_alarms stops both. d2_prison_08 logic_warning: a klaxon (radius 3000, 48), a warning light and screen on for 1.75 s, the relay calling itself every 2.5 s until logic_warning_kill.

Nova Prospekt repeats it (d2_prison_05, 07): four slumped zombies (slump_a > slumprise_a2, slump_b > slumprise_b, m_fMoveTo 4) wake from a trigger_once ahead or their own OnDamaged; one relay wakes three @0, 0 and 0.5, spawns a fourth from a template and Kills the trigger; each zombie's OnDeath Kills its sequence.
